_comment: Real WebReg response captured 2026-11-15 (Spring 2027, signed in) to the second authorized live add of CSCI-103 section 29966, sent by extension 0.1.2 (87c44c4) with WebReg's X-CSRF header. The section then appeared in myCourseBin (Registered 0, Scheduled 1). Token scrubbed; no cookies or personal data. The body is empty: WebReg's own handler (handleAddCourseBin) reads only the status, 200 meaning added.
